bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
root="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"
test "$(realpath "$root")" = /home/gace/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot || exit 70
stage="$root/.worktrees/shared-client-compat-80f98bc"
test "$(git -C "$stage" rev-parse HEAD)" = 80f98bcb8d019586d428bc9b91b3c2cba1fa81d4 || exit 71
docker image inspect gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:clientcompat-80f98bc >/dev/null || exit 72
old="$(docker ps --filter label=com.docker.compose.service=gaybbs --format '{{.ID}}')"
test "$(printf '%s\n' "$old" | sed '/^$/d' | wc -l)" -eq 1 || exit 73
project="$(docker inspect --format '{{index .Config.Labels "com.docker.compose.project"}}' "$old")"
test -n "$project" && test "$project" != "<no value>" || exit 74
prior="$(docker inspect --format '{{.Image}}' "$old")"
docker image inspect "$prior" >/dev/null || exit 75
docker tag "$prior" gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:pre-clientcompat-20261119 || exit 76
(cd "$root/deploy" && docker compose -p "$project" -f gserver-compose.yaml config -q) || exit 77
docker tag gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:clientcompat-80f98bc gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:local || exit 78
if ! docker compose -p "$project" -f "$root/deploy/gserver-compose.yaml" up -d --no-deps --force-recreate gaybbs; then
 docker tag gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:pre-clientcompat-20261119 gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:local
 docker compose -p "$project" -f "$root/deploy/gserver-compose.yaml" up -d --no-deps --force-recreate gaybbs || true
 exit 79
fi
new="$(docker ps --filter label=com.docker.compose.service=gaybbs --filter label=com.docker.compose.project="$project" --format '{{.ID}}')"
test "$(printf '%s\n' "$new" | sed '/^$/d' | wc -l)" -eq 1 || exit 80
for i in $(seq 1 25); do docker logs "$new" 2>&1 | grep -q 'GAYBBS_BOT_READY' && break; sleep 1; done
docker logs "$new" 2>&1 | grep -q 'GAYBBS_BOT_READY' || exit 81
systemctl --user is-active --quiet gace-userbot-verify.service || exit 82
echo SHARED_CLIENT_COMPAT_GAYBBS_LIVE_PASS
